wall_pushups.name: Wall push-ups
wall_pushups.description: Stand an arm's length from the wall, palms at chest height. Bend your elbows under control, then push back.
wall_pushups.tip: Keep your body straight as a plank; don't let your hips sag forward.

chair_sit_to_stand.name: Sit-to-stand from a chair
chair_sit_to_stand.description: Sit on the edge of a stable chair. Stand up by pushing through your heels, then sit back down slowly.
chair_sit_to_stand.tip: Don't drop into the chair; the slow lowering is what works the muscles most.

standing_calf_raises.name: Calf raises (with support)
standing_calf_raises.description: With your hands resting lightly on a wall or chair back, rise onto your toes as high as you can, hold for a second and lower.
standing_calf_raises.tip: Excellent for getting the blood moving after long periods of sitting.

shoulder_rolls_and_reach.name: Shoulder rolls and gentle reaches
shoulder_rolls_and_reach.description: Roll your shoulders in large circles backwards, breathing deeply. Then reach your arms gently towards the ceiling.
shoulder_rolls_and_reach.tip: Let your shoulders drop away from your ears.

glute_bridge_gentle.name: Glute bridge (on the floor or a firm bed)
glute_bridge_gentle.description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders.
glute_bridge_gentle.tip: Gently squeeze your abs and glutes at the top, without over-arching your back.

seated_knee_lifts.name: Seated knee lifts
seated_knee_lifts.description: Sit tall on a chair. Lift one knee towards your chest keeping your abs engaged, lower it and repeat with the other.
seated_knee_lifts.tip: Don't lean back as you lift the knee.

chest_opener_stretch.name: Chest opener at a wall or doorway
chest_opener_stretch.description: Place your forearm on a door frame or wall and rotate your torso gently away until you feel a pleasant stretch across the chest.
chest_opener_stretch.tip: Breathe calmly and deeply; don't force the stretch.

incline_pushups.name: Incline push-ups (on a desk or chair back)
incline_pushups.description: Rest your palms on a stable surface (a sturdy table or sofa). Lower your chest under control and push firmly.
incline_pushups.tip: The higher the surface, the easier it is.

knee_pushups.name: Knee push-ups
knee_pushups.description: Support yourself on palms and knees, torso in a straight line. Lower your chest towards the floor with elbows at 45°, then push firmly.
knee_pushups.tip: Keep your abs engaged; don't let your lower back sag.

box_squat_touch.name: Squat to a chair touch
box_squat_touch.description: Lower into a squat until your hips just touch the chair, then stand straight back up without fully sitting down.
box_squat_touch.tip: Your knees track in the direction of your toes.

wall_sit.name: Wall sit
wall_sit.description: Press your back against the wall and slide down as if onto a chair until your knees are at 90°. Hold still.
wall_sit.tip: Press your heels firmly into the floor and keep breathing steadily.

prone_cobra.name: Gentle cobra (floor back extension)
prone_cobra.description: Lie face down with arms alongside your body. Lift your chest slightly off the floor, drawing your shoulder blades back and turning your thumbs towards the ceiling.
prone_cobra.tip: Look towards the floor to keep your neck relaxed and aligned.

bird_dog_gentle.name: Bird-dog (stability on hands and knees)
bird_dog_gentle.description: On all fours on a mat. Extend your right arm forward and left leg back at the same time, hold for two seconds, then switch.
bird_dog_gentle.tip: Imagine balancing a glass of water on your back that you don't want to spill.

deadbug_assisted.name: Assisted deadbug
deadbug_assisted.description: On your back with knees at 90 degrees. Lower one heel towards the floor keeping your back pressed into the mat, then return.
deadbug_assisted.tip: If you feel your back arching off the floor, don't lower the heel all the way.

crunches_standard.name: Classic crunches
crunches_standard.description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Lift only your shoulder blades by contracting your abs, hold for a second and lower slowly.
crunches_standard.tip: Don't pull on your neck; keep your chin away from your chest and look up at 45°.

side_plank.name: Side plank on knees
side_plank.description: On your side, resting on your forearm with elbow under shoulder and knees bent at 90°. Lift your hips into a straight line from knees to shoulders.
side_plank.tip: Keep your neck straight and don't let your hip drop towards the floor.

dumbbell_seated_bicep_curl.name: Seated biceps curls (dumbbells)
dumbbell_seated_bicep_curl.description: Seated on a chair with a dumbbell in each hand. Bend your arms lifting the weights towards your shoulders, then lower slowly.
dumbbell_seated_bicep_curl.tip: Keep your elbows fixed at your sides.

dumbbell_seated_shoulder_press.name: Seated shoulder press (dumbbells)
dumbbell_seated_shoulder_press.description: Sitting tall, press the dumbbells from ear height towards the ceiling without snapping your elbows straight.

towel_pull_apart.name: Towel pull-aparts
towel_pull_apart.description: Standing or seated, hold a towel taut between your hands at chest height. Pull the ends apart as if to tear it, squeezing your shoulder blades, then release slowly.
towel_pull_apart.focus: Upper back, shoulder blades and posture
towel_pull_apart.tip: Keep your elbows nearly straight and your shoulders down, away from your ears.

reverse_snow_angels.name: Reverse snow angels
reverse_snow_angels.description: Lie face down, forehead resting, arms alongside your body. Lift your arms slightly off the floor and sweep them slowly overhead, then back to your hips.
reverse_snow_angels.tip: The movement is small and slow; what matters is that your arms never touch the floor on the way.

doorway_row.name: Doorway row
doorway_row.description: Stand facing a solid door frame, grip the edge with both hands and place your toes near the threshold. Lean back with arms extended, then pull yourself upright squeezing your shoulder blades.
doorway_row.tip: The further back you lean, the harder it gets — set the difficulty with the angle, not the reps.

band_pull_apart.name: Band pull-aparts for the back
band_pull_apart.description: Hold the band with both hands in front of your chest, arms straight. Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest.
band_pull_apart.tip: Excellent for correcting shoulders that round forward.

band_seated_row.name: Seated row with a resistance band
band_seated_row.description: With your legs extended, loop the band under your feet. Pull the ends towards your abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
band_seated_row.tip: Keep your chest open and your shoulders down.

active_hang.name: Active hang from the bar
active_hang.description: Grip the bar firmly and let your body hang, but pull your shoulder blades down and push your shoulders away from your ears. Breathe calmly.
active_hang.focus: Spinal decompression, shoulder stability and grip strength
active_hang.tip: Releases pressure from the spine and prepares the shoulders for pull-ups.

standard_pushups.name: Full floor push-ups
standard_pushups.description: Support on palms and toes. Lower your chest under control to within 5 cm of the floor, keeping your body straight as a plank, then push firmly.
standard_pushups.focus: Chest, triceps, shoulders and trunk strength
standard_pushups.tip: Your elbows form an arrow at 45 degrees to your torso, not flared straight out.

full_squats.name: Full squats
full_squats.description: Feet shoulder-width apart. Lower your hips below knee level, keeping your heels planted and your chest proud.
full_squats.tip: Breathe in on the way down and drive through your heels on the way up.

forearm_plank.name: Forearm plank
forearm_plank.description: Support on forearms and toes. Your body forms a rigid line from heels to crown. Squeeze your abs and glutes.
forearm_plank.tip: Don't let your hips drop, and don't pike them up into a tent.

reverse_lunges.name: Reverse lunges (alternating)
reverse_lunges.description: Take a big step backwards and lower your knee towards the floor to 90 degrees. Return by pushing through the front heel.
reverse_lunges.tip: Keep your torso upright and your front knee in line with your ankle.

chair_dips.name: Chair dips
chair_dips.description: With your back to the chair, place your palms on the front edge of the seat. Lower your hips alongside the chair bending your elbows to 90 degrees, then push back up.
chair_dips.tip: Stay close to the edge of the chair throughout the movement.

mountain_climbers.name: Mountain climbers
mountain_climbers.description: From a push-up position, drive your knees towards your chest alternately at a quick, controlled tempo, without rocking your hips.
mountain_climbers.tip: Keep your shoulders directly above your palms.

dumbbell_bent_over_row.name: Bent-over dumbbell row
dumbbell_bent_over_row.description: Torso hinged forward at 45 degrees, back perfectly flat. Pull the dumbbells towards your hips, contracting your back muscles hard.
dumbbell_bent_over_row.tip: Don't pull with your arms; start the movement from your shoulder blades.

single_leg_glute_bridge.name: Single-leg glute bridge
single_leg_glute_bridge.description: On your back, extend one leg into the air and push through the other heel to lift your hips. Hold for a second at the top.
single_leg_glute_bridge.focus: Deep glutes, hamstrings and pelvic stability
single_leg_glute_bridge.tip: Keep your hips level; don't let one side drop.

chin_ups.name: Chin-ups (underhand grip)
chin_ups.description: Grip the bar with palms facing you, shoulder-width apart. Pull your chest towards the bar until your chin clears it, then lower slowly.
chin_ups.tip: The underhand grip uses the biceps more, making it a natural and accessible movement at intermediate level.

negative_pullups.name: Negative pull-ups (controlled lowering)
negative_pullups.description: Jump lightly or use a chair to get your chin above the bar. Lower yourself as slowly as you can (3–4 seconds) until your arms are fully extended.
negative_pullups.focus: Eccentric strength, back, arms and grip
negative_pullups.tip: Controlled lowering is the fastest way to build up to full pull-ups.

hanging_knee_raises.name: Hanging knee raises
hanging_knee_raises.description: Hanging from the bar with straight arms and firm shoulders, raise your knees towards your chest under control without swinging, hold briefly and lower slowly.
hanging_knee_raises.focus: Lower abs, hip flexors and grip endurance
hanging_knee_raises.tip: Avoid swinging your torso — the movement must come strictly from the abs.

dumbbell_goblet_squat.name: Goblet squat (dumbbell at the chest)
dumbbell_goblet_squat.description: Hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both palms. Lower into a deep squat keeping your chest lifted and elbows between your knees, then drive firmly through your heels.
dumbbell_goblet_squat.focus: Quadriceps, glutes, hip mobility and trunk stability
dumbbell_goblet_squat.tip: The weight held at the front engages your abs and helps you go deep without rounding your back.

dumbbell_romanian_deadlift.name: Romanian deadlift (with dumbbells)
dumbbell_romanian_deadlift.description: Feet hip-width apart, dumbbells in front. Push your hips back with only a slight knee bend, lowering the dumbbells below your knees with a perfectly flat back, then squeeze your glutes as you rise.
dumbbell_romanian_deadlift.tip: The movement is pushing your backside towards the wall behind you, not bending at the waist.

dumbbell_floor_press.name: Dumbbell floor press
dumbbell_floor_press.description: Lie on your back with knees bent. Press the dumbbells above your chest until your arms are straight, then lower slowly until your triceps lightly touch the floor.
dumbbell_floor_press.focus: Chest, triceps and shoulder joint stability
dumbbell_floor_press.tip: The floor stops the elbows travelling too far, protecting the shoulder joints even with heavy weights.

dumbbell_single_arm_row.name: Single-arm row supported on a chair
dumbbell_single_arm_row.description: Rest one knee and one hand on the chair, back horizontal. With the other hand, pull the heavy dumbbell towards your hip contracting the shoulder blade, hold briefly and lower under control.
dumbbell_single_arm_row.focus: Lats, rhomboids, biceps and single-side back strength
dumbbell_single_arm_row.tip: Don't rotate your torso; keep your shoulders parallel to the floor.

dumbbell_farmers_carry.name: Farmer's carry
dumbbell_farmers_carry.description: Hold a heavy dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Keep your shoulders drawn back and chest up, and step slowly and deliberately (or simply hold the posture on the spot).
dumbbell_farmers_carry.focus: Grip, forearms, traps, abs and postural stability
dumbbell_farmers_carry.tip: Stay perfectly upright; don't let the weights pull you forwards or sideways.

diamond_pushups.name: Diamond push-ups
diamond_pushups.description: Place your palms on the floor under your chest, thumbs and index fingers touching in a diamond shape. Lower and push explosively.
diamond_pushups.tip: Keep your elbows close to your torso.

jump_squats.name: Explosive jump squats
jump_squats.description: Lower into a deep squat and explode into a vertical jump. Land softly on the balls of your feet and flow into the next descent.
jump_squats.focus: Explosive leg power and cardiovascular endurance
jump_squats.tip: The landing should be silent and springy to protect your joints.

plank_shoulder_taps.name: Plank with shoulder taps
plank_shoulder_taps.description: From a push-up position, lift your right hand and tap your left shoulder without moving or rocking your hips. Repeat alternately.
plank_shoulder_taps.tip: Widen your feet a little for better stability.

burpees_clean.name: Clean burpees (no pause)
burpees_clean.description: From standing, drop into a squat, kick your feet back into a push-up position, do a push-up, come back and jump up.
burpees_clean.tip: Find a steady rhythm and hold it.

pullups_standard.name: Pull-ups
pullups_standard.description: Grip the bar with palms facing away, slightly wider than shoulder-width. Pull your body up until your chin clears the bar.
pullups_standard.tip: Start the movement by pulling your elbows down and back.
